qa.user_verbatim_complaint: inline card hides most of a long command summary in the visible one-line header
qa.complaint_resolution_evidence: The dev measurement artifact contains a Codex Terminal inline card candidate with desktop hiddenDelta=0 and mobile hiddenDelta=0, but the associated screenshots do not show that exact long-card target and the wrapped target becomes 2870px tall on desktop and 3445px tall on mobile. That fails the compact/bounded header criterion and prevents a PASS.

complaint_element_pointer.how_located: Existing dev measurement artifact candidates[1] for both desktop and mobile; text starts with Terminal and the long /bin/bash command summary, textLength=8608.

qa.overall_assessment: FAIL. The implementation removes hidden horizontal clipping for the measured long Codex Terminal inline summary, but it does so by allowing an unbounded multi-thousand-pixel header. The provided screenshots show a different short Terminal card rather than the measured 8608-character target, no trace artifact exists, and QA could not complete the mandatory rebuild/live Playwright verification because Bash and MCP Playwright were blocked in this harness.
